articles.summary: José Carlos Díez’s article, based on Banco de España’s Household Finance Survey, highlights the structural transformation of households’ financial position in Spain. Families are less indebted, less exposed to real estate, and gradually taking on more financial risk. However, these improvements coexist with long-term stagnation in living standards and ongoing challenges in employment and wages.
articles.title: Lower debt, higher liquidity: The quiet transformation of household finances in Spain

articles.summary: The report released by the Spanish Institute for Strategic Studies, authored by Ramón Casilda Béjar, examines the EU–Mercosur Association Agreement from an economic, geopolitical and strategic perspective. The report argues that the agreement goes far beyond trade by representing a commitment to multilateralism, European strategic autonomy, and the creation of a shared economic and political space amid growing global competition between the US and China.
articles.title: EU–Mercosur: Beyond trade in a fragmented global order

articles.summary: The report “The UK Financial Services Sector Has Lost Its Edge—Here’s How to Win It Back”, published by Boston Consulting Group (BCG), argues that while the UK financial sector retains global strength, it has been suffering from structural deterioration since the global financial crisis, which has weakened finance’s role as a driver of economic growth. Against this backdrop, lending to UK businesses has fallen to its lowest level in almost 30 years, standing at 59% of GDP in the third quarter of 2025, compared with close to 90% at the 2008 peak. BCG attributes this trend to a combination of excessive regulatory risk aversion, weak economic growth, technological underinvestment, and declining competitiveness compared to the US and Asia. The report sets out a broad range of concrete proposals to reposition the sector through AI, digital assets, and a new relationship between regulators and the financial sector.
articles.title: How the UK can win back financial competitiveness
